data.title: Four-Digit Place Value Explorer
data.description: Learn to read and understand place values in four-digit whole numbers using base-ten blocks.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones carefully from left to right.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Check each column to make sure you didn't miss any groups of blocks.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Remember to look closely at the empty column where a place value might have zero blocks.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands first, then check the tens and ones.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Look at the ones column carefully before naming the final total.
